synthetic_inputs.why: Hourly forecast for the front (prototype is daily). Rain starts Fri 20 13:00 on the plain; daily totals, daily max gusts and daily mean winds are kept.

source_text.title: Front Fri 20 - Sun 22 Nov: no spraying, strong gusts
source_text.body: Rain 27.5 mm on the plain; gusts up to 55 km/h, 70 km/h on Geraneia (north wind Sun). Last spray day before it: Wed 18 Nov.
source_text.action: Finish sprays Wed 18. Remove/secure fleece Thu. Irrigation off Fri-Sun. Harvest planned cuts by Fri morning.
source_text.why_rule: No spray when gust > 20 km/h, rain within 24 h of application, or leaves wet.

notes: 'Last spray day Wed 18' is not asserted: under the rule, Thu 19 late morning can still be open on P1 (rain starts ~25 h later). Severity Medium per RULES ('a front closing every window').
